title: The server rejects your key
fault: The injection removes the practice key from authorized_keys and disables password authentication.
prompts: Did the server accept your key?
What identities did your client offer?
hints: Run the command with -v, and read the Offering public key lines.
The server can hold your key type and still refuse your key.

reveal.wrong: The injection removed your public key from authorized_keys, so the server rejects the offer.
reveal.fix: Install the public key on the server again, or offer the key the server knows.
